brief: A compact desk unit with a drawer, plus a spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform.

requirements.requirement: Compact desk unit with a drawer
requirements.evidence: 3 bases at 0,0,0 / 0,1,0 / 1,0,0 forming compact cluster; notch drawer frame hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf placed at 1,1,0 (ref notch:0#1,1#notch2) which fills empty position between two cells and includes integrated drawer per catalog description

requirements.requirement: Spike at a corner where three bases meet to hold a small platform
requirements.evidence: Spike mount variant at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (ref spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0) – the single point where the three bases meet – with accessory platform-sm attached via setSpikeAccessory

finish.summary: Compact 3-base desk unit with notch drawer frame providing drawer and mount spike with small platform at the three-way junction; meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
